reason: 本文を確認したが、対象系統との接続またはLLM推論効率の実証が弱く、一般化可能性を確認できない。RagVL trains an MLLM as an image reranker and adds visual noise during training for multimodal RAG. Evaluation is on two image-retrieval/reasoning datasets; the paper does not report inference compute/latency or KV-cache improvements.
title: MLLM Is a Strong Reranker: Advancing Multimodal Retrieval-augmented Generation via Knowledge-enhanced Reranking and Noise-injected Training
